description:
ShardPilot helps shorten CI feedback by splitting JVM test classes into deterministic,
    non-overlapping shards for parallel CI jobs. Gradle and Maven adapters share balancing based on
    historical test durations, stable hashing when timings are unavailable, YAML class manifests and
    standalone JSON and HTML reports for verifying class selections. This parent POM supplies shared
    dependency and build configuration for shardpilot-core and shardpilot-maven-plugin. Consumers
    configure the appropriate build-tool adapter; class-selection verification complements normal
    test result checks.
